files_written.what: The slice: flat map of 100 dotted keys to Chinese (9 deliberately byte-exact English). Flat dotted keys, never nested - lang_gap.py confirms UNREACHABLE 0.

Per-key rationale for all 100 keys: en value, shipped cn value, new value, changed flag, source class (glossary / stratum A / ruling / own / deliberately-English), and reason with re-derived file:line citations. _meta carries the measured 590/511 counts and the changed/unchanged/english split.

Added a keep_english_reasons block (was 9071 bytes). The 8 crit-parse keys were ALREADY in keep_english when I arrived, so I did not touch that list, never_write, or the existing _README - verified byte-identical via round-trip. What I added is the per-key phase-1 reasoning the brief asked for: why each of the 8 is frozen, which side of the contract it sits on (comparison vs output), the EN DASH U+2013 warning, the Phase-5 target values, and the note that the 8 flip together with the RollTables in one commit. All three readers consume only keep_english and never_write, so a sibling key is inert - re-verified by re-running apply_lang --dry afterwards.

summary:
Phase 1 slice `lang-combat`: 100 keys covering the ranged-attack dialog, range bands, cover/size modifiers, weapon and armor vocabulary, damage, the whole critical-injury pipeline, initiative/combat tracker, action economy, and ALIENRPG.dialog.*. 80 keys change relative to the shipped system cn.json, 20 adopt stratum-A values verbatim, 9 are deliberately English (the 8 crit-parse lockstep keys plus ALIENRPG.CriticalInjuries).

Re-derived, not trusted: en.json flattens to 590 leaves, cn.json to 511 (93 en keys missing from cn, 14 cn-only dead keys) - both match the brief. Every file:line in the notes was resolved against the installed alienrpg 4.1.13 this session; three citations I drafted from a wide sed window were wrong (config.mjs size_modifiers is 438-440 not 479-481; crit-roll-character.hbs CriticalInjuryfor is line 4 not 5; the enricher CTRL comment is 116 not 115) and were corrected before delivery.

Gates: apply_lang.py --dry = 100 applied / 0 rejected (9 "no CJK" warnings, all on keep_english keys). An independent self-gate (stricter: order-sensitive HTML tag sequence, frozen-literal cross-check against the 55 English literals extracted from DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json, full-width-colon scan, whitespace hygiene on the lockstep group) = 0 failures. Applying the slice to a throwaway repo and running scan_crit_lockstep.py gives checked=8 violations=0; lang_gap.py on that repo gives UNREACHABLE 0 (flat dotted keys, no nested-shadow trap), DRIFT 0, UNTRANSLATED 0, NEVER-WRITE 1 (EVCriticalInjuries, correctly absent), NEW 489 = 590 - 100 - 1.

The three-way range collision stays dissolved: Engaged=接战, Melee(weapon type)=肉搏, and 近战 appears nowhere in my file (it belongs to the Close Combat skill, not my slice). Long=远距离 vs Ranged=远程 also stays split. Armor Piercing=破甲 per R2.

I did NOT write to 1-系统汉化插件/lang/cn.json - verified still `{}` with its original 06:41 mtime.

Most actionable finding: sibling slices landed while I worked and I checked overlap. lang-core = 0 overlap, but lang-ship overlaps me on 11 keys (5 with different values) and lang-ui on 16 (12 different). 25 distinct keys are double-claimed, 17 with a value disagreement, 2 three-way. Details in open_issues - the controller must arbitrate before assembling, because apply_lang.py is last-write-wins and will silently take whichever batch lands last.

decisions.decision: Claimed 100 keys under the rule: the key's ENGLISH VALUE is combat / range / cover / weapon / armor / damage / critical-injury / initiative vocabulary - not which sheet displays it.
decisions.reason: A sheet-based rule would have split the range band set across three slices (Short/Medium/Long/Extreme label personal, vehicle AND ship weapons alike), which is exactly how the shipped cn.json ended up with 远程 meaning two different things.

decisions.decision: Did NOT claim the 12 ALIENRPG.Skill* keys even though SkillcloseCbt and SkillrangedCbt are combat words.
decisions.reason: They are T-EXACT and byte-coupled to the skill-stunts Item names; a skills slice is their natural owner and splitting that contract across two agents is how it gets broken. Flagged so the controller can confirm someone owns them - note the glossary now differs from the shipped values on five of the twelve (Comtech 科技->通信科技 per R3, Observation 观察->侦察, Manipulation 操纵->操控, Survival 求生->生存, Heavy Machinery 机械->重型机械), and each change must land in the same commit as the pack Item rename.

decisions.decision: Did NOT claim ALIENRPG.Overwatch ('OVERWATCH' -> 守望先锋, a headline defect) or ALIENRPG.TAH.overwatch.
decisions.reason: config.mjs:113-114 puts Overwatch inside the classic status-effects array next to Dehydrated/Exhausted/Freezing/Encumbered/Panicked/Radiation, and TAH.overwatch is one of seven TAH.* tooltips. A conditions/status slice is the natural owner. If no such slice exists, this defect ships - glossary_alien.json says 警戒.

decisions.decision: Did NOT claim ALIENRPG.keepingguard / seekcover / the other Evolved condition keys, nor the generic roll-dialog family (HOWMANYDICE, HOWMANYSTRESS, MODIFIER, Dial*, Ones, Sixes, Dice, Rolled, Rolling, DRAW).
decisions.reason: Conditions and generic rolls are their own coherent contracts. ALIENRPG.HOWMANYDICE ('How Many Base Die?' -> 有多少基地死亡？) is on the brief's named-defect list and is NOT in my slice - the controller must confirm the rolls slice has it.

decisions.decision: Claimed 14 ship-adjacent keys anyway: SHIP-ARMOR, ARMAMENTS, Armament, Bonus, DAMAGE, Offensive, Defensive, Contact, Surface, REPAIRROLL, ComponentDamagefor, SelectFirer, MAJOR-/MINOR-COMPONENT-DAMAGE.
decisions.reason: They are pure weapon/armor/damage/range words that must read the same at every scale - e.g. provenance's Armor entry names SHIP-ARMOR=盔甲 specifically as a stratum-B residue contradicting ALIENRPG.Armor=护甲. This is the source of most of my collision with lang-ship; where lang-ship disagrees I recommend deferring to it on the sheet-chrome ones.

decisions.decision: Dropped the leading space from ALIENRPG.targetRange (' Range to Target' -> 目标距离).
decisions.reason: handlebars.mjs:28 capitalise does charAt(0).toUpperCase(), a no-op on both a space and a Chinese character, so the leading space is pure upstream noise in a form-group label. My self-gate flags it as the one intentional whitespace divergence.

decisions.decision: KEPT the leading space on ALIENRPG.healthDamage (' HEALTH Damage' -> ' 生命值伤害').
decisions.reason: YZEDiceRoller.mjs:263 splices it inside a <span> where the space is doing spacing work. But lang-ui claims the same key as '点生命值伤害' with no leading space, and at :268 the call site is sTotal + ' ' + localize(...) - so lang-ui's version renders '3 点生命值伤害' while mine renders '3  生命值伤害' with a double space. I recommend the controller take lang-ui's value here; mine is the more conservative one, theirs is the better one.

decisions.decision: Used full-width parentheses with ASCII digits and ASCII +/- inside for the cover and size modifiers: 无掩护（0）半掩护（-2）全掩护（-3）普通（0）大型（+2）小型（-2）仔细瞄准？（+2）瞄准弱点（-2）.
decisions.reason: The parentheses sit directly against Chinese characters, where full-width is conventional. Flagging it because it is a house-style call the controller may want to normalise across slices - no code compares these values (config.mjs target_cover / size_modifiers store id and value separately from label).

decisions.decision: Wrote all 100 keys including the 20 where I adopt the shipped value unchanged.
decisions.reason: The module is a key-for-key override channel. An omitted key silently inherits the upstream value, which works today but has no defence against upstream drift - and the notes file records for each of the 20 that I checked it rather than skipped it.

decisions.decision: Kept ALIENRPG.Shift English despite the glossary saying otherwise.
decisions.reason: glossary_alien.byrole.json's lang.value role for Shift says emit 班, and it is right on the mechanics: actor.mjs:1890 compares a BARE literal with no localize(), and :1891 uses ALIENRPG.Shift purely as OUTPUT, so translating it is safe in isolation. I followed the brief's constraint 1 instead and recorded the disagreement in the file, in the notes, and in open_issues rather than silently picking a side.

decisions.decision: Fixed a number, not just wording, in ALIENRPG.RollManShipMinorCrit.
decisions.reason: English is 'Number must be between 1 and 66'; the shipped Chinese says 1 和 44. The Spaceship Minor Component Damage table is d66. This is a content error in the shipped translation, not a style one.

glossary_gaps.why: The Evolved edition's rename of the Engaged band (config.mjs:409, :424, :476 - evolved_weapon_range_list, evolved_vehicle_weapon_range_list, evolved_ship_weapon_range_list). Absent from glossary_alien.json, from .pending.json, and from .provenance.json. I deliberately did NOT reuse 接战 because that is pinned to Engaged and Adjacent is a positional, not a combat-state, description. This is the band a Chinese player sees most often in Evolved worlds, so it deserves a ruling rather than my default.

Vehicle weapon range band 1 (config.mjs:417, value '2') and gRng case '6' (handlebars.mjs:120). Absent from all three glossary artifacts. Literal rendering; 抵近 or 贴近 are alternatives if the controller wants something less clinical.
Ship weapon range band 7 (config.mjs:473 and :481) and gRng case '7' (handlebars.mjs:123) - firing from orbit at a planetary surface. Absent from all three glossary artifacts.

Weapon property (item-weapon.hbs:31) plus the attack-dialog checkbox 'Firing Full Auto?' (ALIENRPG.firingFullAuto). Not in the glossary. Standard rendering, but it is a weapon property name that will also appear in pack item text, so it should be on the spine before Phase 2.

Two keys carry this English value and the key NAMES are misleading: ALIENRPG.Rounds and ALIENRPG.Rds are BOTH en='Reloads'. item.mjs:628 concatenates localize('ALIENRPG.Rounds') + ' ' + localize('ALIENRPG.Supply'), and Supply=余量检定 per the glossary, so the rendered string is 备弹 余量检定. The shipped values are 弹药 (collides with ALIENRPG.ammo) and 重新加载 (a verb, unusable as a count column header). Needs a spine entry because the weapon item template will repeat it.

glossary_gaps.en: Roll (as a UI action button, vs. Roll as the noun)
glossary_gaps.proposed: 投骰 for the button role; 检定 stays the noun
glossary_gaps.why: glossary_alien.json pins Roll=检定 and provenance justifies it (en-gated 10 vs 滚动 9, with every 滚动 hit stratum-B MT). That is right for the noun. But ALIENRPG.dialog.roll is the literal 'ROLL' confirm button, and ALIENRPG.DialRoll (not my slice) is the same problem. This is exactly the shape glossary_alien.byrole.json exists to express - I propose a role split so the rolls slice and I do not diverge. I used 投骰 for dialog.roll pending the ruling.

glossary_gaps.en: Fatal / Time Limit / Healing Time / Injury / Effect
glossary_gaps.proposed: 致命 / 时限 / 治愈时间 / 伤势 / 效果
glossary_gaps.why: These five are the crit chat-card field headers (crit-roll-character.hbs:12/16/20/24/28) AND they mirror the FATAL: / TIME LIMIT: / HEALING TIME: / INJURY: / EFFECTS: labels inside the RollTable result text. The lang values are display-only and safe now, but in Phase 2/5 the table cells must be rewritten to match, and that is a hard sync point. The first four I adopted from stratum A; Effect I changed 影响->效果 because a field header needs the noun. None of the five is on the spine - they should be before the tables are touched.

config.mjs:464-465 ship_weapon_type_list. Not on the spine, and lang-ship independently chose 进攻型 / 防御型 - an immediate live divergence that proves the term needs a ruling rather than two agents' defaults.

glossary_gaps.proposed: 次要部件损坏 / 主要部件损坏
glossary_gaps.why: config.mjs:149 and :155 status icons, plus crit_list[0]/[1] at :508-509. Not on the spine. The shipped pair 轻微/主要 is not parallel; lang-ship independently chose 轻微/重大 with 损伤 instead of 损坏. Whichever wins, ALIENRPG.ComponentDamagefor must use the same head word. Note these lang values are sheet labels only - the RollTable names 'Spaceship Minor/Major Component Damage' stay frozen English per the register.

open_issues: HIGHEST PRIORITY - SLICE COLLISIONS, DETECTED LIVE. lang-ship.json and lang-ui.json appeared in 6-工作区/phase1/ while I worked. 25 distinct keys are claimed by two slices, 17 with disagreeing values, 2 three-way. apply_lang.py is last-write-wins per key, so assembling in arbitrary order silently picks a winner. lang-ship (11 overlap, 5 disagree): ARMAMENTS 武器装备/武装 · ComponentDamagefor 部件损坏，目标/部件损伤对象 · MAJOR-COMPONENT-DAMAGE 主要部件损坏/重大部件损伤 · MINOR-COMPONENT-DAMAGE 次要部件损坏/轻微部件损伤 · Offensive 攻击型/进攻型 (agreeing: Defensive, REPAIRROLL, RollManShipMajorCrit, RollManShipMinorCrit, SHIP-ARMOR, SelectFirer). lang-ui (16 overlap, 12 disagree): ArmorDoubled 护甲加倍/护甲翻倍 · CombatantReroll 重投先攻/重掷先攻 · NoCharCrit 没有重伤表/找不到重伤表 Critical injuries · NoSynCrit 没有合成人重伤表/找不到合成人重伤表 Critical Injuries on Synthetics · RollManCharCrit 输入 D66 点数/输入 D66 数值 · RollManCrit 手动进行重伤检定/手动指定重伤 · RollManShipMajorCrit · RollManShipMinorCrit · RollManSynCrit 输入 D6 点数/输入 D6 数值 · healthDamage ' 生命值伤害'/'点生命值伤害' · hideInitChatHint (trailing period only) · noAmmo 你需要重新装填！！/你需要重新装弹！！ (agreeing: OutofRange, SwapInitiative, ammoConcerved, hideInitChat). Three-way: RollManShipMajorCrit, RollManShipMinorCrit. MY RECOMMENDATIONS where one side is clearly better rather than merely different: take lang-ui's healthDamage 点生命值伤害 (the call site at YZEDiceRoller.mjs:268 already adds a space, so mine produces a double space and theirs renders '3 点生命值伤害'); take lang-ui's NoCharCrit/NoSynCrit with the English table-name tail (the GM needs the exact English name to import the table, and those table names stay English by design - see ALIENRPG.CriticalInjuries in keep_english); defer ARMAMENTS/ComponentDamagefor/MAJOR-/MINOR-COMPONENT-DAMAGE/Offensive to lang-ship, which owns the spacecraft sheet; keep RollManShipMinorCrit either way since both slices independently fixed the 44->66 number bug.

ALIENRPG.Shift - the brief's constraint 1 and glossary_alien.byrole.json disagree, and I followed the brief. byrole's lang.value role says emit 班 and is mechanically correct: actor.mjs:1890's testArray[9] === "Shift" is a bare literal with no localize(), and :1891 uses ALIENRPG.Shift purely as OUTPUT, so this one key could be translated today with zero risk. I kept it English so the 8-key group stays one lockstep unit that flips with the tables in Phase 5. If the controller prefers byrole, translating it is safe - but it must simultaneously be removed from lang_keep_english.json's keep_english list, or apply_lang's 'translation equals English' check will stop guarding it.

Keeping ALIENRPG.None English has a visible cost beyond the crit path: config.mjs:484 uses it as the label for ship_weapon_targetmod_list[1], so the spaceship target-modifier dropdown reads 'None' in English. Same shape for ALIENRPG.CriticalInjuries - config.mjs:143 uses it as a status-effect label, so the 'roll a crit' token-HUD icon tooltip reads 'Critical injuries'. Both are the documented price of the runtime lookups; recording them so nobody files them as bugs later.

UPSTREAM BUG, not ours: ALIENRPG.Close is referenced at config.mjs:468 (ship_weapon_range_list key 6) but does not exist in en.json or cn.json - re-derived with grep, zero hits in either lang file. The classic ship-weapon range dropdown therefore displays the raw string 'ALIENRPG.Close'. I did NOT add the key: apply_lang.py gate 1 rejects any key absent from en.json, and adding one would take our module outside the key-for-key override contract. The inconsistency is upstream's own - handlebars.mjs:120 maps the same band 6 to ALIENRPG.Contact, so the sheet display and the dropdown disagree even in English. Worth an upstream report (PROJECT.md 7.4).

UPSTREAM i18n GAP: enricher.mjs:16 and :34 build the draw-from-table tooltip as `Draw from ${tableName}.
${localize('ALIENRPG.dialog.Tooltip-Rollontable')}` - the 'Draw from ...' half is a hardcoded English literal with no key, so it cannot be translated from our side at all. Only the second half is localizable, which is what I translated.

Three of the eight ALIENRPG.dialog.* keys are DEAD in 4.1.13 - dialog.roll, dialog.howManyDice, dialog.Tooltip-ManualRoll have zero references (grep over *.mjs/*.js/*.hbs/*.html found only ok, cancel, Modifier, Rollontable, Tooltip-Rollontable, all in enricher.mjs). I translated them anyway so the module is correct if upstream wires them up. Recorded per-key in the notes.

Five more keys in my slice are dead in 4.1.13 and translated defensively, flagged individually in the notes: ALIENRPG.Weapons (only InventoryWeaponsHeader is live), ALIENRPG.Armament, ALIENRPG.NotActive, ALIENRPG.CombatantUpdate (CBTracker.mjs:8 now uses core's COMBAT.CombatantUpdate), ALIENRPG.CombatantRemove (CBTracker.mjs:43, commented out). METHOD NOTE: my first grep missed ALIENRPG.SwapWith because I only searched *.hbs - it is live in templates/dialog/switch-initiative.html, which is .html not .hbs. Any live/dead audit of this system MUST include *.html; templates/actor/tabs/ and templates/actor/crt/ hold .html files too.

ALIENRPG.Days ('Days') is dead and unclaimed by me. It is not obviously combat vocabulary despite looking crit-adjacent - the crit healing-time ' days' tail comes from the RollTable cell (re-emitted verbatim as regex group 2 at actor.mjs:1894), not from this key. Someone should still own it.

Not verified by me because it is out of scope for a lang-only phase: my Chinese values for Fatal / TimeLimit / HealTime / Injury / Effect are display-only TODAY, but they become a hard byte-level sync point the moment the crit RollTables are translated in Phase 2/5. The table's structural invariant (ASCII colon-plus-space inside each , '
' spelled exactly that way, the double '

' in spaceship rows) is what produces the 10-element array - see DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json crit_parse_lockstep. Nothing I wrote touches that, but whoever writes the tables must read my notes file for the header wordings.
